text:
ana: quick report from a customer POC — their client hits a 429, triggers token refresh, then the client immediately retries and creates duplicate invoices. stack: node sample app + hosted API.

jon: not surprising. sample app doesn't add an Idempotency-Key by default and our retry logic is linear+no jitter. that combo is fragile when auth rotates.

lee: can we do three quick things: auto-add `Idempotency-Key` in sample app, switch to exponential+full jitter, and make retries pause until token-refresh finishes?

ana: (typo) ana: yep that's my vote. showing the safe pattern in the onboarding code is important.

jon: suggested backoff snippet (full jitter):
```js
const base = 150;
const backoffMs = () => Math.floor(Math.random() * (base * Math.pow(2, attempt)));
await sleep(backoffMs());
```

lee: for token race: when auth flow starts emit `auth.refreshing` and when done emit `auth.updated`. retry queue should listen and delay draining until `auth.updated`. keeps retries from using stale tokens.

ana: also telemetry: add `retry.event` with attrs: code, attempt, route, sampled and a `duplicate.detected` counter when server returns an idempotency conflict. small sampling (1%) for payloads.

jon: I'll prototype the queued-retry handshake in node and python SDKs. can we add a small repro script in sample app `scripts/repro-token-race.sh` that forces a 429 then rotates token so new hires can run it?

lee: yes please. also update README line: "sample app enables idempotency by default to demonstrate safe retry patterns."

devex-bot: checklist created and assigned: @ana sample app patch, @jon SDK retry queuing. paste PR links here. :white_check_mark:

ana: (ana) i'll open a draft PR with tests that assert no duplicate created under simulated 429+refresh. linking when ready. thanks all.
